answers.description: A small Go tool that makes a local **stdio** MCP server reachable from a remote agent, by automating the wrap-in-a-service + expose-through-a-tunnel setup people do today by hand.

intent.goal: Make a local stdio MCP server reachable from a remote agent with one command, replacing a 489-line manual procedure with a tool that executes it and verifies it down to a real MCP initialize handshake.
intent.users: Users of local stdio MCP servers (mcp-standardnotes, mcp-freestyle, mcp-nightscout first), anyone with a VPS-hosted agent needing to reach an MCP on a personal machine, and gateway operators who would consume the primitive once for the gateway.
constraints: Go 1.24, single distributable binary, stdlib-first (Cobra + TOML)
MVP boundary: macOS (launchd) + Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) + macOS keychain, one implementation per seam
Preconditions assumed never created: cloudflared installed with a named authenticated tunnel, mcp-proxy available
No secret in config, service file, or command line - referenced by name, fetched at launch, fails loudly if absent
Health must be a real probe; a health check that cannot fail is worse than none
Open source implies Linux users - the seams exist so Linux is additive, not a rewrite
nonGoals: Not a gateway: no UI, no filtering, no skills, no aggregation
No Cloudflare Portals registration inside the primitive
No Linux/systemd, no non-keychain SecretSource, no tailscale/ngrok/reverse-proxy exposers
No multiple config files or profiles
apply never removes an entry deleted from the config
acceptanceCriteria: ensure_exposed and remove_exposed are idempotent inverses; second apply on a healthy entry is a no-op
HealthReport carries checked facts (proxy_listening, mcp_initialize, hostname_resolves, hostname_responds, service_loaded) and names which check failed
No secret value in config.toml, a launchd plist, argv, or a log; set-secret reads a masked stdin prompt only
A referenced-but-absent secret fails at start, loudly
Exit codes compose: 0 all healthy, 1 precondition failed, 2 at least one entry unhealthy
The mcp-standardnotes reference case works end to end from one config entry plus apply
